{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:\n', df.head())

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print('\nNumber of unique patient_id:', df['patient_id'].nunique())
print('Total rows:', len(df))
print('Number of duplicate patient_id rows:', len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for sentinel value -999 in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}')

# Check assay_batch values
print('Unique assay_batch values:', df['assay_batch'].unique())"}
